title: Interrupted Patterns on an Ordinal Alphabet: Minimal Markov Chain Embeddings and Exact Distributions — replication code
description:
Replication code for the paper Interrupted Patterns on an Ordinal Alphabet: Minimal Markov Chain Embeddings and Exact Distributions.

Every number, table and figure in the paper is produced by this code. Running python run_all.py reproduces all reported results from scratch; requirements.txt records the dependencies and Output/environment.json the software environment under which the published results were obtained. No result depends on execution timing.

The code builds the finite Markov chain embeddings for four interrupted pattern families on the ordinal alphabet {normal, warning, critical}, computes their exact mass functions and moments by scalar recursion, verifies each embedded chain against exhaustive path enumeration, brute-force exact probabilities, independently counted simulation and a block-decomposition channel, and checks the minimality of the embedded dimensions by partition refinement.
